title: Governed dispatch request
description: Closed, total structural schema for a governed dispatch-request JSON document (model-economy S4). Design authority: data/model-economy/ord-223-report.md §F (field table, cross-field rules, examples), brief §6. additionalProperties:false enumerates every admitted field, each fully typed; any property the schema does not positively admit is a failure. This schema proves STRUCTURE ONLY (types, enums, closed key set, array uniqueness, formats). The cross-field/cross-artifact SEMANTIC rules of §F (profile projection against the S3 manifest, task-class membership, the Fable/Opus-xhigh justification gates, parent linkage, live repo-state agreement) carry their own §F denial codes and are proven by bin/fm-dispatch-validate.sh as named checks over this already-type-proven document — the permitted residue the S3 ruling (data/me-s3-profiles/design-ruling.md) allows beyond declarative schema. Fields whose REQUIREDNESS is conditional (§F 'required when') are admitted+typed here but not in 'required'; their conditional presence is a named check emitting the specific code, so an empty why_opus_is_insufficient is FABLE_JUSTIFICATION_MISSING rather than a generic structural error. requested_model and selected_profile are validated for null/absence ahead of this schema (MODEL_REQUIRED / PROFILE_REQUIRED) and for value/governance after it (MODEL_PROFILE_MISMATCH / PROFILE_NOT_GOVERNED); configured_effort deliberately EXCLUDES 'max' from its enum, so Opus-max and Fable-max fail closed here by construction (§F field table: 'max is never a valid member of this governed enum').
